claims.conditions: A person who owns the decisions is present and answering in the same session, and the subject is a plan, decision or design that is not yet settled. The agent may read the environment and may dispatch a fresh-context sub-agent for fact-finding.
claims.rationale: The source directs the agent to interview the user in numbered rounds over a 'design tree': ask every question whose prerequisites are settled, give a recommended answer for each, then wait for the user's answers before the next round (lines 6-26). It separates facts from decisions: 'Finding facts is your job, never the user's', while 'The decisions are the user's: put each to them and wait' (line 28). It ends only when the frontier is empty, and adds 'Do not act on it until the user confirms' (line 30). Every decision therefore routes through the person; the agent's autonomous part is limited to fact-finding. Plausible failure modes: with no responder the frontier never empties, so the procedure cannot terminate as written; because questions are worded so that 'yes' accepts the agent's recommendation (line 24), an acquiescent user can ratify the agent's own plan with the appearance of review. The claim is falsified if a session that has loaded this text edits files or takes another action on the plan before the user has confirmed, and qualified if the recommended-answer wording is shown to move decisions toward the agent's proposal.
